block.youtube.model.title: YouTube
block.youtube.model.description: Search videos, read details and manage playlists and uploads on YouTube.
block.youtube.security_hint: The API key and the OAuth grant stay in the wallet. Nothing is uploaded, changed or removed until the matching switch is enabled.
block.youtube.apply_hint: Changes remain local until Apply. Restart a loaded Run to use new settings.
block.youtube.invalid_number: Check the numeric value and its limits.
block.youtube.help_enabled: Off by default. While off, no request reaches Google and the wallet is never read.
block.youtube.help_api_key_ref: Wallet reference holding a YouTube Data API key, used for public reads. Never the key itself.
block.youtube.help_secret_ref: Wallet reference holding an access token, or JSON with client_id, client_secret and refresh_token. Needed for uploads, changes, private data and channel mine.
block.youtube.help_read_credential: api_key reads public data with the API key; oauth reads with the grant, including the owner’s private and unlisted videos.
block.youtube.help_operation: Used when a request gives no operation. playlist_add, upload_video and update_video need Allow changes; playlist_remove needs Allow playlist removals.
block.youtube.help_allowed_operations: JSON array among search, video_details, channel_uploads, playlist_items, comments, watch_uploads, playlist_add, playlist_remove, upload_video and update_video. The default operation is always allowed.
block.youtube.help_channel: Channel ID (UC...), @handle, channel URL or mine, used by channel_uploads, watch_uploads and the watch when a request names none.
block.youtube.help_list_limit: Upper bound for one listing; a request limit can only lower it.
block.youtube.help_allow_writes: Off by default. Required for playlist_add, upload_video and update_video, and for the file input. Videos are never deleted.
block.youtube.help_allow_delete: Off by default. Required for playlist_remove, which takes an item out of a playlist; the video itself stays on YouTube.
block.youtube.help_upload_root: Local videos may only be uploaded from inside this folder. Required for upload_video; symbolic links leaving it are refused.
block.youtube.help_max_upload_bytes: Larger files are refused before any request. Default 268435456 (256 MiB).
block.youtube.help_default_privacy: Privacy of uploaded videos when a request gives none; private by default.
block.youtube.help_default_category_id: YouTube video category of uploads when a request gives none, for example 22 (People & Blogs) or 27 (Education).
block.youtube.help_made_for_kids: Audience declaration sent with uploads when a request gives none (selfDeclaredMadeForKids).
block.youtube.help_notify_subscribers: Off by default. When on, YouTube may notify the channel’s subscribers about a new upload.
block.youtube.help_watch_enabled: Off by default. In Active Runtime, emits each new upload of the default channel on the changed output. Existing uploads are not replayed.
block.youtube.help_watch_interval_sec: Time between two checks, at least 300 seconds. Also the minimum spacing of watch_uploads requests.
block.youtube.help_watch_max_items: New uploads beyond this number wait for the next check.
block.youtube.label_emit_existing: Emit existing uploads at the first check
block.youtube.help_emit_existing: Off by default: the first check only records the current uploads. On: it also emits the newest ones, up to Uploads per check.
block.youtube.help_page_size: Items requested per page; YouTube returns at most 50.
block.youtube.help_max_pages: Bound on the pages read by one listing, comments request or playlist lookup.
block.youtube.help_search_max_pages: Each search page costs 100 quota units of the 10,000 a Google Cloud project gets per day by default.
block.youtube.help_timeout_sec: Total time for one request or one watch check, token exchange and retries included.
block.youtube.help_upload_timeout_sec: Total time for one upload_video, every chunk and resumption included.
block.youtube.help_upload_chunk_bytes: Bytes sent per upload request, a multiple of 262144 (256 KiB). Smaller chunks resend less data after an interruption.
block.youtube.help_max_retries: Reads and video updates retry after HTTP 429, a rate-limit 403, 5xx or a lost connection; playlist changes only after a rate limit; uploads resume.
block.youtube.help_max_retry_wait_sec: A Retry-After above this value returns rate_limited instead of waiting.
block.youtube.help_max_response_bytes: Larger JSON responses from Google are refused as protocol errors.
block.youtube.help_api_base_url: Keep https://www.googleapis.com. Another origin receives the credentials; plain HTTP only for a loopback test host.
block.youtube.help_oauth_base_url: Keep https://oauth2.googleapis.com. Used only with a refresh-token grant; plain HTTP only for a loopback test host.
block.youtube.help_ca_file: Optional absolute PEM file for a privately signed HTTPS origin. TLS verification cannot be disabled.
